about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Quinquagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly food may through it be protected against all adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we who have received heavenly food
may be protected against all adversity
